info.title: Wheelwright v2 Account evidence, Positions and transaction history
info.description: Bounded source retention, exact-row evidence admission and Position reads. No sophisticated historical reconciliation or recommendations. Canonical opaque resource identities, Account discovery and authorized-scope collections; persistence structure does not determine URI hierarchy. First-class User identity, authenticated self inspection and explicitly administrator-only User discovery; fixed many-to-many User–Account authorization. Account-nested transaction history is a retained-first backend facade with one explicit Account history grant and policy-bounded source acquisition. No strategy/tax/P&L interpretation.

post.summary: Retain and process a CSV Artifact
post.description:
Transactionally retain exact bytes and original filename before parsing. Same account/hash reuses generated immutable artifact identity; every upload records a filename/processing attempt. REJECTED processing is HTTP 200, source survives and prior admitted evidence remains. Positions admit snapshots. Other files admit source-row observations; History appends/matches exact row occurrences without deleting prior observations. Corrections, lifecycle projection and continuous-history coverage are unresolved. Interrupted calls may leave PENDING; inspect inventory then retry retained processing. File-type/source-period interpretations are bounded; filename account attribution is qualified when History/Balances omit account ID. Content/admission deduplicates; import-attempt identities do not. Import requires artifact write authority for the target Account only. Exact mixed-account originals are retained privately. Formats without supported row-level Account attribution are retained with REJECTED processing rather than admitting mixed rows. Complete original-file retrieval separately requires artifact read authority for every source Account; unregistered source scopes deny retrieval. Optional accountId narrows that scope and cannot expand authority. Account relationships are in representations, not URI ancestry. Aliases are never accepted as IDs. Upload requires filename-bearing Content-Disposition and X-Brokerage-File-Type; missing or invalid upload inputs return INVALID_REQUEST/422 before retaining bytes. The body media type must be text/csv (compatible parameters are allowed).

<!-- internal-only:start -->
Positions processing admits only target-account rows and does not grant access to other Accounts. Collections include only backend-authorized Account scope. Bearer credentials resolve to stable Users; permissions are read from committed backend User authority, independently of credential strings or Account ownership.
<!-- internal-only:end -->

### Supported Fidelity CSV exports

Submit existing Fidelity exports, preserving their envelope, case-sensitive column labels, account attribution and source dates. The type selects an interpretation; arbitrary CSV with similar values is not an interchangeable export. UTF-8 with an optional BOM and CSV quoting for commas, quotes and embedded newlines are supported. Required column labels describe export shape, not a requirement that every cell be nonblank.

| X-Brokerage-File-Type | Required columns | Export envelope and row rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POSITIONS | Account number; Account name; Investment type; Symbol; Description; Quantity; Current value; Total gain/loss dollar; Type | Start with the header row. Preserve the Date downloaded MMM-dd-yyyy footer and its remaining download-time text. Requested-account rows establish attribution; preserve their broker account identity. At least one requested-account row is required. Conflicting account names or truncated rows reject processing. Blank/-- quantities and Cash or missing investment types are excluded from holdings; a counted holding needs a Symbol. |
| ACTIVITY | Run Date; Action; Symbol; Amount ($) | History export with the header as the first nonblank row and original History_for_Account_{broker-account}.csv filename (supported broker download suffixes may follow the account token). Filename attribution is qualified because content omits account identity. Each data row needs a valid M/d/yyyy or M-d-yyyy Run Date and nonblank Action; Symbol may be blank. Rows must cover all header columns. Empty history can be accepted and does not establish lifetime coverage. |
| BALANCES | Balance; Day change | Balances export with the header as the first nonblank row and original Balances_for_Account_{broker-account}.csv filename (supported broker download suffixes may follow the account token). Attribution is qualified. At least one complete data row is required. Additional exported columns are retained as source observations; they do not themselves establish Portfolio Capital. |
| OPTION_SUMMARY | Symbol; Strategy; Expiration & Strike; Quantity | Preserve the opening Fidelity Investments - Option Summary {broker-account} section marker, optional Quote data as of metadata, and the subsequent header. At least one complete data row is required. Broker strategy presentation does not establish Position identity or share ownership. |

Brace-delimited account tokens above are placeholders, not example account numbers or Wheelwright accountId values. Preserve the broker-supplied filename and content instead of constructing attribution from a Wheelwright ID. Except for Positions' supported target-account row selection, unsupported mixed-account row attribution rejects processing. Preserve recognized broker footers; unknown envelopes, duplicate headers, malformed quoting or truncated data can fail processing. Balances and Option Summary retain source rows without inventing numeric or lifecycle meaning. History retains row occurrences; later normalized transaction reads apply their own date/decimal interpretation.

### Retention versus processing rejection

Missing/invalid upload headers, accountId, media type or byte size return 422 before source retention. After retention, unsupported brokerage/format, invalid UTF-8, unsupported account attribution, missing required columns/export date or malformed data produce HTTP 200 with status REJECTED and a safe result message. The source remains retained and prior admitted evidence remains intact; no partially admitted rows from the failed processing attempt become success. Inspect status, not HTTP 200 alone. A syntactically valid CSV request-shape example is not a promise of successful evidence admission. Retry reads the retained bytes and recorded filename/type; it cannot repair an incompatible source export.

parameters.name: Content-Disposition
parameters.description: A parseable Content-Disposition containing filename or RFC 5987 filename*. The decoded original filename must be nonblank, at most 255 characters, and contain no slash, backslash, C0 controls or DEL. It is retained provenance, not identity. post.description:
Explicit backend holdings acquisition for one canonical Account. No request body, orders, history or quote acquisition. Exactly one canonical accountId selector, no request body or other query. Unconfigured provider or unsupported brokerage is 503. No orders/history/quotes/scheduler. Securities interpretation is all-or-nothing; accepted snapshot and attempt outcome commit together. Failed refresh preserves previous evidence and its clock. Pagination requiring more than one page is retained/rejected rather than misreported as complete. Every response has X-Request-Id and private,no-store. A separately timed settled-cash companion response is retained in the existing Artifact/import owner when available. Securities ACCEPTED does not imply cash completeness: the result and holdings snapshot qualifications identify the cash outcome. Cash source failure preserves securities evidence; cash, securities and receipt clocks do not establish an atomic brokerage cut, buying power or reservation.

<!-- internal-only:start -->
Explicit backend-only OAuth and holdings acquisition. Authentication then exact Account acquisition authority before source/storage access. Account reads, artifact writes, quote acquisition and ID possession do not grant acquisition. Successful JSON bodies pass credential-safety checks before immutable exact-byte retention. OAuth responses, headers and upstream errors are not retained or disclosed.

get.description:
Pure read of accepted retained originals in one committed inventory. One row per admitted Balances artifact; unique identical reported export-minute Option Summary produces Portfolio Capital = Total Account Value minus aggregate short-option MTM. This is a two-source composite, not an atomic brokerage observation. No same-day/nearest/predecessor pairing, daily collapse, interpolation, historical knowledge replay or NAV claim. Missing, malformed, ambiguous or unmatched required values remain null with explicit row status. Complete parsed Summary without short options establishes zero; missing MTM never does. ExportedAt has MINUTE precision in America/New_York, independently of quoteDate and receipt time. Every row preserves both source hashes/IDs/rows. Duplicate timestamps retain all Balance rows with AMBIGUOUS_EXPORT_MINUTE. Response order exportMinute ASC NULLS LAST then artifactId ASC. Coverage remains UNKNOWN. Complete collection with 10000 artifact/32MiB input limit; capacity or hash failure returns 503 without partial output. Non-Fidelity Account is 422.

<!-- internal-only:start -->
Required canonical accountId and existing account.artifacts.read grant; CLI resolves nicknames with account.read. Every original must have established single requested Account source scope, with existing original-disclosure protections, else whole read is 403. Only accountId is allowed, exactly once; all other/repeated/blank params and nonempty GET bodies are 422 after authentication and applicable Account authorization. Known authorized empty Account returns 200 empty.
<!-- internal-only:end -->

200.description: Complete retained export-minute composite inventory; null values are uncomputed.

get.description:
Retained-first backend DB read; optional policy-bounded full source scan. Default read-through disabled; reuse 300 seconds when enabled. Source paging has one shared 10-second deadline, 100-page/25000-row/16MiB source limits; capacity or source failure never truncates into success. Complete scan admits atomically; failed scan preserves prior history and returns complete=false with retained/incomplete context. Provider source pages are not claimed atomic. Lifetime coverage remains UNKNOWN. No GET body. Requests without query retain existing full-history/read-through behavior. Instance lookup never searches outside the selected Account. Complete bounded JSON only; 16MiB response capacity fails with 503. No Order-state, strategy grouping or tax computation; bounded closed-trade projection is specified below. Fidelity serves retained admitted CSV activity without acquisition; row-equivalence identity does not establish a unique broker event. No-argument CLI history composes these Account-scoped resources.

<!-- internal-only:start -->
Explicit account.transactions.read grant required. Account and transaction IDs confer no permission. Original source access remains separately governed; the existing raw-artifact scope screen fails closed for unsupported transaction envelopes.
<!-- internal-only:end -->

With mode=retained, this is a bounded provider-free query of existing admitted transaction evidence. Fidelity projection may normalize already-retained activity locally. No brokerage refresh occurs. Defaults25/max100 rows and100000 serialized bytes; capacity fails503. Exact source symbol and inclusive transaction dates are optional. Preserve all selectors and limit with nextCursor until pageComplete. Changed retained evidence invalidates the cursor422. matchedRecordCount is retained query coverage, never lifetime completeness; complete retains its existing history coverage meaning and does not imply this page is final. Source actions, reported gross value, net cash and fees remain distinct; matching a source symbol does not identify an opening cohort or associate a current construction. No premium or strategy inference. Requests without query preserve legacy read-through semantics; bounded selectors require explicit mode=retained or mode=policy. Item reads continue rejecting queries.
Bounded mode also accepts order=asc|desc (default asc); reverse the existing date/execution-time/transaction-ID total order only, not a freshness or identity inference. MCP requests desc to inspect recent retained evidence first. Order is included in cursor scope and selection.

October29 governed projections: mode=policy reuses the existing authorized backend read-through/reuse policy, while mode=retained remains provider-free. First-page read-through has the existing10-second shared provider budget; subsequent pages do not refresh and changed evidence invalidates the opaque cursor. Response remains bounded100000 bytes/default25/max100 rows or whole groups. No User/grant changes or autonomous polling.

view=execution-groups: explicit from/through/timeZone, source executedAt interval, native Order-ID grouping without splitting a group between pages. Source actions establish OPENING/CLOSING/MIXED/UNRESOLVED; buys/sells alone do not. Reversals, missing native Order identity and unknown actions cannot become confirmed exits. Reported gross transaction-value sums preserve known currency, never infer multiplier or opening basis. Full Order fill status, submitted time, strategy and Position/Construction association are not established by this projection and Order read permission is not bypassed. Coverage scan upper bound differs from observed transaction dates. Current provider path lacks verified lower bounds, so empty source results do not establish no executions. VERIFIED_TO_CUTOFF is reserved for an independently backend-established scoped coverage assertion, never inferred from first/last rows or client input.

view=closed-trades: Principal-selected reported closed-round-trip net P/L view with row outcomes and totals. Match exactly one earlier native opening package to one native closing package by native contracts, whole quantities and opposing open/close source actions. All same-contract observations must belong solely to the pair; other cohorts, adjustments/reversals, partial closes, unknown net/currency or closes spanning the period remain unavailable. This bounded method introduces no FIFO, tax-lot or governed Position identity. Opening net cash outside the report month remains in the matching basis. Sum already-net source cash once; do not subtract fees twice or assume omitted fee components are zero. Preserve QUALIFIED_ESTIMATED_FEES when the broker reports estimates or final status is unknown. Net total and winners/losers are unavailable if a returned trade cannot be reconciled or currencies conflict. The report covers matched reported closed trades, not total Account investment performance, unrealized P/L or complete lifetime/period brokerage coverage. Source histories and evidence remain available separately; no raw ledger dump is required.

get.description:
Pure provider-free projection of accepted retained TASTYTRADE API_BALANCES and FIDELITY BALANCES originals. Distinct brokerField and meaning preserve cash, equity/options/day-trading buying power, margin requirements and reserve dialects. No universal deployable-capital mapping, debt derivation, strategy permission, per-put collateral, governance allocation or order preview. No model arithmetic establishes financial findings. currentness is always NOT_ESTABLISHED and historyCoverage UNKNOWN. Empty observations means no selected accepted balance original, never zero buying power. Original bytes remain private; only allowlisted numeric fields are projected. Missing, invalid or duplicate fields never silently become zero. Exact decimal JSON numbers retain source precision; clients must parse losslessly. Tastytrade source updated-at and snapshot-date survive separately from first artifact receipt. Fidelity export minute (America/New_York) is separate from unknown source observation time; currency is unknown and unit SOURCE_MONETARY_UNIT. Receipt ordering does not establish source-time ordering or latest/current state after trades. Collection order receivedAt then artifactId ascending; content-deduplicated originals are not a complete observation-attempt history. Select optional artifactId to narrow to an exact original. Complete collection limit 200 artifacts /32 MiB; capacity/hash failure returns 503 without partial output. Unsupported brokerage is 422.

<!-- internal-only:start -->
Canonical accountId and existing account.artifacts.read for that exact Account required before storage. Nickname resolution additionally requires ordinary account.read; no new grants are introduced. Original scope must be positively established as the single requested Account; otherwise whole read is 403. Only one accountId and optional single artifactId allowed; unknown/repeated/blank query parameters, nonempty GET body and malformed correlation are 422 after authentication/applicable authorization. No provider calls, filesystem capability or change to acquisition permissions.
<!-- internal-only:end -->

Bounded selection: selection=latest-source scans and validates originals backend-side but returns at most one observation. Source ordering uses tastytrade updated-at or Fidelity export minute, never receipt. Tied maximal source times are AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE_TIME with zero observations; all unknown clocks produce NO_ORDERABLE_SOURCE_TIME. A sourceAtOrAfter miss returns NO_MATCHING_SOURCE_TIME and the latest known retained source time. Some unknown clocks permit only a qualified maximum among known times, not a complete chronology. Currentness remains NOT_ESTABLISHED. Default all and exact artifactId reads preserve prior semantics. Financial glyphs in reportedDisplay come from validated broker scalar text; a dollar glyph does not create an ISO currency determination.
Fidelity cash-account dialect also preserves exact Available to trade and Cash and credits labels; these are not aliases for Available without margin impact and do not establish Operating Regime deployable capital.

get.description:
Provider-free read of the existing backend-selected latest retained custody cut per metadata-authorized Account. Filters right and side backend-side; exact BigDecimal contract counts cover only selected returned rows. Unknown option rights and denied Accounts are explicit and invalidate complete-count status. Snapshot coverage is separate from read completeness; selectedInventoryComplete does not establish complete brokerage coverage or live state. Missing retained custody is not an empty live Account. Cash-secured-put count is null: this read establishes neither collateral nor construction identity. Related long options are same-Account/source-cut/underlying/right/expiration context only, never a spread association. Adjusted contracts retain incomplete terms. Fidelity export day and tastytrade backend receipt are distinct clocks. No provider acquisition, strategy permission, governed allocation or trading recommendation. At most 100 Accounts, 1000 source holdings per Account and 200000 serialized bytes; capacity fails 503 without a partial result. Account visibility does not establish ownership. Unknown/repeated selectors, GET body and malformed correlation fail 422 after authorization.

<!-- internal-only:start -->
Existing account.read selects visible scope; each Account additionally requires account.holdings.read. Explicit Account lacking metadata permission is 403 before lookup. Missing holdings permission appears as a per-Account FORBIDDEN with no private rows. No new grants or Account permission inference.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer credentials identify a stable immutable User. Committed backend User state authorizes resource access; IDs and client filters confer no authority. users.admin is an explicit backend privilege, not implied by Account access.

importId.description: Opaque retained processing-attempt identity. CSV imports and holdings acquisitions use a UUID; transaction source pages use acquisition UUID plus hyphen and zero-based page offset. Not an idempotency key.

contentType.description: Exact retained source media type: imported Fidelity CSV or backend-acquired tastytrade JSON.

evidenceDate.description: Fidelity export day, or UTC backend receipt day for tastytrade. Not an opening or broker event timestamp.

evaluationBasis.description: Derived fields use evaluatedAt over retained inventory; no historical knowledge or evaluation replay.

PositionCollection.description: Positions with their account relationship and account snapshot evidence context; a constituent is counted once within its account.

brokerAssociation.description: Broker label only. Ordinary Account metadata omits brokerage account numbers; internal broker bindings are not disclosure authority.

Account.description: Authorized Account metadata: stable identity, nickname, display name and broker label. No full or masked brokerage account number is disclosed.

positionsAcquire.description: Explicit Account acquisition capability; independent of metadata, Position reads, artifacts and quotes. Defaults false on migration.

transactionsRead.description: Explicit Account history facade grant; includes only policy-bounded read-through.

holdingsRead.description: Independent broker-custody observation read; no Position or Order grant implied.

ordersRead.description: Read-only brokerage instructions and authorized Order-derived facts.

positionsAuditRead.description: Retained Wheelwright Position audit; no missing brokerage history implied.

marketRead.description: Private Account market/source evidence; global market.read is also required for observations.

UserAccountAccess.description: One explicitly established backend User–Account relationship; multiple Users may access one Account and one User may access multiple Accounts.

User.description: Stable backend-generated User identity, independent of Account IDs and credential rotation. No credential or bootstrap subject is exposed. Administrator privilege enables User inspection only; Account capabilities remain separately authorized.

HoldingsObservation.description: Backend request/receipt interval, not a package valuation clock or atomic brokerage event timestamp. No history-completeness claim.

PositionObservationContext.description: Date-field interpretation only; no exact broker observation, event time or intraday chronology.

evidenceDate.description: Fidelity export day, or UTC backend receipt day for tastytrade. Not an opening or broker event timestamp.

PositionObservationCollection.description: All retained admitted observations in authorized scope, exactly once. Empty success; no brokerage-history completeness claim.
